# Trimble Maps Routing Profile API

- **Product:** Trimble Maps Routing Profile API (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Bearer token. Declared security schemes: Bearer.
- **Access:** Trimble Maps fleet administrators.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Maps API key or token.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.trimblemaps.com`.
- **Definition:** [trimble-maps/vehicle-routing-profile](https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/api/vehicle-routing-profile.json) ( Routing Profile API, version v1). Documentation: https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/routing/vehicle-routing-profiles/api-documentation/.
